article.title: 1.6 million join general strike in France against austerity
article.author: Editor
article.content: Around 1.6 million people took to streets across France during Thursday’s general strike, protesting Emmanuel Macron’s austerity policies. The post 1.6 million join general strike in France against austerity appeared first on MR Online .
